name: Greatsword of the Skeleton King
description: A powerful sword used by the King of Skeletons
fullDescription: The Greatsword of the Skeleton King is a legendary diamond sword that once belonged to the ruler of all undead skeletons. It radiates with ancient power and grants the wielder enhanced combat capabilities.

sections.title: Enchantments
content: Fire Aspect II - Sets enemies ablaze

sections.title: How to Obtain
content: Dropped by the Skeleton King boss

name: Greatsword of the Zombie King
description: A powerful sword used by the King of Zombies
fullDescription: The Greatsword of the Zombie King is a formidable netherite blade that was forged in the depths of decay. More powerful than its skeletal counterpart, it grants superior damage and survivability.

sections.title: Enchantments
content: Fire Aspect IV - Burns enemies intensely

sections.title: How to Obtain
content: Dropped by the Zombie King boss

name: The Legendary Slime Sword
description: Legend Says It Was Forged By The King Himself
fullDescription: The Legendary Slime Sword is a mythical weapon said to have been forged by the Slime King himself. It is one of the most powerful weapons in the realm, granting massive combat bonuses and incredible mobility.

sections.title: Enchantments
content: Fire Aspect II - Sets enemies ablaze

name: Magmarite
description: Forged By The Nether King In The Nether Wastes
fullDescription: Magmarite is an extraordinarily powerful blade forged by the Nether King himself in the scorching Nether Wastes. This weapon channels the raw power of the nether and is among the strongest weapons in existence.

name: Exorcist
description: Upgrade For The Legendary Magmarite Blade
fullDescription: The Exorcist is the ultimate evolution of Magmarite, representing the pinnacle of weapon crafting. This legendary blade combines the raw power of the Nether King's forge with additional mystical enhancements, making it the strongest sword in the entire realm.

name: PermaFrost
description: Forged By The Magical Frost Elemental Of The Arctic
fullDescription: PermaFrost is a legendary ice blade forged by the Frost Elemental in the frozen wastes of the Arctic. This sword channels the power of eternal winter and can freeze enemies with its touch.

sections.title: Enchantments
content: Fire Aspect II - Paradoxical cold burn

name: FrostBite
description: Upgraded from the Legendary PermaFrost!
fullDescription: FrostBite is the ultimate form of PermaFrost, enhanced with additional frost materials. This weapon represents absolute zero made manifest, capable of freezing anything it touches instantly.

sections.title: Enchantments
content: Fire Aspect II - Intense cold burn

name: Lights Bane
description: A Weapon Manifested From The Corruption Of The World
fullDescription: Lights Bane is a manifestation of pure corruption, born from the darkness that threatens to consume the world. This unholy weapon channels the power of the Corrupt King and represents one of the most powerful swords in existence.

sections.title: Upgrade Path
content: Can be combined for Night's Edge

name: Night's Edge
description: A Combination Of All The Worlds Strongest Weapons!
fullDescription: Night's Edge is the ultimate weapon, forged by combining all of the world's most powerful legendary swords. This blade transcends the power of any single dimension, channeling fire, frost, and corruption simultaneously.

name: Butchers Axe
description: I'll Cut You Down!
fullDescription: The Butcher's Axe is a fearsome weapon wielded by the most brutal warriors. This massive netherite axe deals devastating damage and strikes terror into the hearts of enemies.

name: Daylight
description: For the glory of Merlin, Daylight is mine to command!
fullDescription: The sacred blade of the Trollhunter, summoned by the Amulet of Daylight. Forged by Merlin himself to slay trolls, this legendary weapon is effective against all Gumm-Gumm trolls and emits a bright aura.

sections.title: How to Obtain
content: Craft the Amulet of Daylight first

name: Eclipse
description: For the doom of Gunmar, Eclipse is mine to command!
fullDescription: The ultimate evolution of Daylight, summoned by the Eclipse Amulet. Transformed by the three Triumbric Stones and specifically forged to kill Gunmar the Black. The only blade capable of ending the Dark Lord.

sections.title: How to Obtain
content: Upgrade Daylight Amulet with Triumbric Stones
Place Eclipse Amulet in crafting table

name: Moonlight
description: For the Doom of Evil, Moonlight is mine to command!
fullDescription: The supreme amulet that transcends both Daylight and Eclipse. Forged by an ancient order of celestial guardians to vanquish all corrupted beasts and dark entities. The divine blade of the Night Guardian, forged under a blood moon with celestial magic.

sections.title: Enchantments
content: Sweeping Edge IV - Greater area damage

name: Decimaar Blade
description: Gunmar's legendary blade, stained with the blood of thousands
fullDescription: Gunmar's legendary Blade, stained with the blood of thousands. It is said that no shield can withstand its crushing blows. This weapon inflicts devastating debuffs and has massive lifesteal.

sections.title: Enchantments
content: Sweeping Edge IV - Maximum area damage

name: Bular's Twin Blade - Right
description: One of Bular's legendary twin swords
fullDescription: One of Bular's legendary twin swords. This blade has ended countless Trollhunters. When dual-wielded with the left blade, grants +20% damage bonus.

sections.title: Set Bonus
content: Dual wield with Left blade for +20% damage
Part of Bular's twin blade set

name: Bular's Twin Blade - Left
description: The companion blade to Bular's right sword
fullDescription: The companion blade to Bular's right sword. Together they are instruments of destruction. Designed for offhand wielding as part of the twin blade set.

sections.title: Set Bonus
content: Dual wield with Right blade for +20% damage

name: Blade of the Shadow Assassin
description: Angor Rot's primary weapon, cursed by the Infernal Shroud
fullDescription: Angor Rot's primary weapon, cursed by the Infernal Shroud. Strikes leave victims weakened and marked for death. Features lifesteal and inflicts devastating wither damage.

name: Shadow Dagger
description: A cursed offhand blade for swift, deadly strikes
fullDescription: A cursed offhand blade used for swift, deadly strikes. Perfect companion to Angor's main weapon for dual-wielding assassin combat.

name: Changeling's Fang
description: A blade that drips with deadly toxins
fullDescription: A blade that drips with deadly toxins. Each cut weakens the victim. Part of the Changeling Shapeshifter Set, inflicts Poison III for 5 seconds.

name: Staff of Avalon
description: The legendary staff of Merlin the wizard
fullDescription: The legendary staff of Merlin the wizard. Channels pure magical energy and can summon protective barriers and healing magic.

name: Corrupted Shadow Staff
description: Corrupted by overuse of shadow magic
fullDescription: Claire's staff, corrupted by overuse of shadow magic. Incredibly powerful but drains the user's life force.

name: Great Enlightened Pickaxe
description: Forged by a legendary miner who delved deeper than any before
fullDescription: His spirit guides your strikes. This legendary pickaxe can mine Tier 1 ores and basic resources.

sections.title: Mining Capabilities
content: Sapphire, Ruby, Topaz, Amber, Jade, Opal, Tungsten

name: Industrial Tungsten Breaker
description: Reinforced with tungsten alloy, designed for dense metal extraction
fullDescription: Heavy-duty mining at its finest. Can mine Tier 2 ores including Tungsten and Magnetite.

name: Electromagnetic Extractor
description: Infused with magnetic properties, pulls ores directly to you
fullDescription: Hums with electromagnetic power. Can mine Tier 3 rare ores.

name: Blessed Electromagnetic Extractor
description: Blessed version with double drop rates for lower tier ores
fullDescription: Blessed By Toolsmith - Grants 2x drops on Tier 1 & 2, and 1.5x on Tier 3 ores.

name: Volcanic Inferno Drill
description: Forged in the heart of a volcano, resistant to extreme heat
fullDescription: Burns away impurities instantly. Immune to Fire Ores (Magmaritian).

name: Glacial Permafrost Breaker
description: Tempered in eternal ice, impervious to freezing temperatures
fullDescription: Never dulls in the coldest depths. Immune to Frost Ores (Glacial Titanium).

sections.title: Special Abilities
content: No freeze damage from Glacial Titanium

name: Elemental Harmonizer
description: Balanced between fire and frost, immune to extreme temperatures
fullDescription: Harmonizes with elemental ores. Immune to both Fire and Frost ore effects.

name: Iridescent Prismatic Drill
description: Shimmers with otherworldly light, eyes adapted to its radiance
fullDescription: Cuts through reality itself. Immune to Radiance Ores (Iridium).

name: Arcane Mining Drill
description: Channels magical energy to extract ores
fullDescription: Whispers ancient mining incantations. Immune to Magic and Radiance Ores.

name: Entropic Nullifier
description: Stabilizes chaotic ore formations, nullifying corrupting effects
fullDescription: Forged in the void between worlds. Immune to Chaos, Magic, and Radiance Ores.

name: Ultimate Pickaxe
description: A legendary tool blessed by divine power
fullDescription: Transcending all mortal limitations. Nothing can resist its perfect edge. The final Pre-Hardmode pickaxe.
